name: Yonex Duora 10 badminton racket ( Master Copy )
description:
Yonex Duora 10 Badminton Racket

Brand: Yonex
Model: Duora 10
Type: Badminton Racket Bat
Flex: Medium-Stiff
Shaft: H.M. Graphite
Frame: H.M. Graphite, Dual Optimum System (DOS)
Weight / Grip Size:

3U: Avg. 88g (G4, G5)

4U: Avg. 83g (G4, G5)
Stringing Advice:

3U: 20–28 lbs

4U: 18–26 lbs
Balance: Even / Slightly Head-Heavy
Features:

Dual Optimum System: One side optimized for powerful forehand smashes, the other for fast backhand shots

Lightweight and aerodynamic frame for quick swings

High-strength shaft for stability and control

Ideal for advanced and professional players seeking versatility

Highlights:

Perfect balance between attack and defense

Delivers precise control, speed, and powerful smashes

Ergonomic handle for comfortable grip
